en.quote: Have I any pleasure at all that the wicked should die? saith the Lord GOD: and not that he should return from his ways, and live?
en.riddle: Have I any pleasure at all that the wicked should die
en.speaker: Lord GOD

he.quote: הֶחָפֹץ אֶחְפֹּץ מוֹת רָשָׁע נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה הֲלוֹא בְּשׁוּבוֹ מִדְּרָכָיו וְחָיָֽה
